name: Ideal.height_le_spanRank_toENat
script:
intro R _ _ I hI
obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ : I.minimalPrimes.Nonempty := by
  first
    | exact Ideal.nonempty_minimalPrimes hI
    | exact Ideal.minimalPrimes_nonempty hI
    | exact Ideal.nonempty_minimalPrimes_of_ne_top hI
    | (obtain ⟨m, hm, hIm⟩ := I.exists_le_maximal hI
       haveI := hm.isPrime
       obtain ⟨q, hq, -⟩ := Ideal.exists_minimalPrimes_le hIm
       exact ⟨q, hq⟩)
haveI hpp : p.IsPrime := by
  first
    | exact hp.1.1
    | exact Ideal.minimalPrimes_isPrime hp
    | exact hp.1.1.1
have hIp : I ≤ p := by
  first
    | exact hp.1.2
    | exact Ideal.le_of_mem_minimalPrimes hp
    | exact hp.1.1.2
have h2 : p.height ≤ Cardinal.toENat (Submodule.spanRank I) := by
  first
    | exact Ideal.height_le_spanRank_toENat_of_mem_minimalPrimes hp
    | exact Ideal.height_le_spanRank_toENat_of_mem_minimalPrimes _ hp
    | exact Ideal.height_le_spanRank_toENat_of_mem_minimalPrimes _ _ hp
    | exact Ideal.height_le_spanRank_toENat_of_mem_minimal_primes hp
    | exact Ideal.height_le_spanRank_toENat_of_mem_minimal_primes _ hp
    | exact Ideal.height_le_spanRank_toENat_of_mem_minimal_primes _ _ hp
    | exact Ideal.height_le_spanRank_of_mem_minimalPrimes hp
    | exact Ideal.height_le_spanRank_of_mem_minimalPrimes _ hp
    | (rw [Ideal.height_eq_primeHeight]
       first
         | exact Ideal.primeHeight_le_spanRank_toENat_of_mem_minimalPrimes hp
         | exact Ideal.primeHeight_le_spanRank_toENat_of_mem_minimalPrimes _ hp
         | exact Ideal.primeHeight_le_spanRank_toENat_of_mem_minimalPrimes _ _ hp
         | exact Ideal.primeHeight_le_spanRank_toENat_of_mem_minimal_primes hp
         | exact Ideal.primeHeight_le_spanRank_toENat_of_mem_minimal_primes _ hp
         | exact Ideal.primeHeight_le_spanRank_toENat_of_mem_minimal_primes _ _ hp)
have h1 : I.height ≤ p.height := by
  first
    | exact Ideal.height_mono hIp
    | exact Ideal.height_le_height_of_le hIp
    | exact Ideal.height_le_of_le hIp
    | (have e : p.height = p.primeHeight := by
         first
           | exact Ideal.height_eq_primeHeight p
           | exact Ideal.height_eq_primeHeight
           | exact (Ideal.primeHeight_eq_height p).symm
           | exact Ideal.primeHeight_eq_height.symm
       rw [e]
       first
         | exact Ideal.height_le_primeHeight_of_mem_minimalPrimes hp
         | exact Ideal.height_le_primeHeight_of_mem_minimalPrimes _ hp
         | (simp only [Ideal.height]; exact iInf₂_le p hp)
         | (unfold Ideal.height; exact iInf₂_le p hp))
    | (simp only [Ideal.height]; exact iInf₂_le p hp)
exact h1.trans h2
